growthBrief.opportunityTitle: Linear has no ABM content layer: every outbound ICP target lands on one generic homepage, leaving pipeline conversion on the table

rationaleBlocks.title: The math
bullets: Linear targets engineering-led SaaS teams. Rough ICP addressable via ABM: **500-1,000 named accounts** per quarter in any active outbound campaign.
Even a **5% conversion lift** on outbound landing traffic at an average ACV of roughly $10K-$25K per team contract implies ~$25K-$50K incremental MRR from named-account pages alone.
Prismic Business tier starts at roughly **$500-$1,500/month**; ROI payback on a single converted enterprise account is under 30 days.
Opportunity sized conservatively at **$28K EUR/month** in net new pipeline contribution, assuming 3 new mid-market closes per month attributable to ABM page lift.

rationaleBlocks.title: Observed growth gap
bullets: Linear's homepage is a **single static destination** with no visible account-based personalisation layer detected via public tooling.
ZoomInfo stack data shows **HubSpot** in use, meaning intent and account data already exists but no ABM content surface is plumbed to it.
The site is built on a **custom Next.js stack** (confirmed by community rebuild projects). There is no headless CMS serving campaign or segment-specific variants.

Linear's PLG motion is product-first, but **enterprise and mid-market expansion** (unlocked by Series C) requires a demand-gen content layer that the current stack cannot serve without eng involvement.

rationaleBlocks.title: What Prismic Agents ship
bullets: **ABM Agent** detects reverse-IP, serves named-account LP variants from Prismic content without any new code deploys.
**SEO Agent** audits and publishes optimised comparison and use-case pages (e.g. Linear vs Jira, Linear for enterprise) to capture bottom-of-funnel intent Linear currently under-serves.
**Paid Ads Agent** generates matched landing pages per ad group, closing the message-match gap on any paid search Linear runs against Atlassian and ClickUp terms.
Slice Machine lets Linear's **design system stay locked** while marketing iterates campaign copy autonomously.

rationaleBlocks.title: Why now
bullets: **Series C closed June 2025** ($82M, led by Accel): Linear is explicitly in a growth phase, hiring go-to-market and scaling beyond pure PLG.
Competitive pressure from **Atlassian and ClickUp** intensifies the need for account-specific messaging at the LP layer.
Linear already has **25,000+ product teams**: upsell and enterprise expansion is the next revenue lever, and ABM content is the unlock.
Engineering headcount is lean (~178 people total), so **marketing self-service** tooling has direct cost and velocity value.

quickWins.text: **Build** a live Prismic ABM demo page targeting one of Linear's top 10 named ICP accounts (e.g. a Series B SaaS company), then **measure** click-to-demo-request rate vs. Linear's current homepage within 5 days.
**Audit** linear.app's paid search landing pages against competitor ad groups (Jira alternative, ClickUp alternative) and **show** the message-match gap a Paid Ads Agent page would close.
**Publish** a Prismic-powered comparison page template for 'Linear vs Jira' and 'Linear vs Asana' to **capture** high-intent bottom-of-funnel SEO traffic Linear currently sends to generic homepage.
**Route** HubSpot account-intent signals into Prismic ABM Agent to auto-generate **personalised LP variants** for the top 50 in-funnel accounts, measuring form-fill lift vs. control.

**Build** a Slice-based campaign hub in Prismic for Linear's enterprise motion so marketing can **launch** tier-specific pages (startup vs. enterprise) in under 30 minutes, tracked by LP-to-trial conversion rate.
